task_title: gitreins tier1 build arm reports FAIL in a fresh worktree that simply lacks node_modules
task_criteria: In a fresh worktree with no node_modules, the tier1 build arm reports SKIP (or a named dependencies-not-installed precondition) instead of FAIL; with deps installed the same tree grades build ok and Overall PASS.

items.criterion: In a fresh worktree with no node_modules, the tier1 build arm reports SKIP (or a named dependencies-not-installed precondition) instead of FAIL; with deps installed the same tree grades build ok and Overall PASS.
items.detail: Skip half verified in prior context: fresh tree extracted via `git archive HEAD | tar -x -C .tmp/df013-fresh` (no node_modules); `bash scripts/guard-build.sh` printed "skipped: dependencies not installed (node_modules absent — run npm ci)" plus `GITREINS_SKIP: build=...` with rc=0. Engine 0.21.0 real path: Pipeline._run_script_step on the config's build step returned passed=True exit=0 with the sentinel in output, and _record_runtime_skips recorded stage passed=True degraded=True skipped_steps=['build'] with reason "skipped at runtime — build: dependencies not installed...". Bounding check: _bound_step_evidence(4000 cap) + parse_skip_sentinels keeps the sentinel in all orderings tested. Last commit 5d69bfc pins the wrapper in tests/ci/ci005-precommit-hook.test.ts so the test asserts the dependency-aware wrapper rather than the bare build command.
